hero.title: Building Reliable Software by Reducing Bugs Before They Reach Production
hero.subtitle: Senior QA Engineer with 5+ years across Tier-1 Indonesian banks, fintech, and capital markets. Specialized in automation frameworks, Bank Indonesia SNAP API testing, and CI/CD-integrated quality engineering.

about.title: About
about.heading: A QA mindset built across regulated industries.
about.paragraph1: I started in QA in 2020 as a Manual QA Engineer on an automotive enterprise platform, then moved into regulated financial industries — banking, fintech, capital markets, and multi-region SaaS. Over 6+ years, I've learned that good quality isn't about finding bugs — it's about building systems and discipline that make bugs hard to surface in the first place.
about.paragraph2: Today I specialize in automation framework design, API testing with cryptographic signatures for Bank Indonesia's SNAP standard, and CI/CD integration for regulated environments. The cross-domain experience trained me to see QA as an engineering discipline, not a checking task.

uco.title: UCO Collect — Multi-Region QA Ownership
uco.problem: Multiple regions (Indonesia, Thailand, Singapore) with inconsistent behavior and high regression risk. No dedicated QA team, requiring a single engineer to own the entire quality lifecycle.
uco.action: Designed structured test scenarios across regions. Built 300+ automated test cases from scratch spanning API, web, and mobile (iOS & Android). Implemented multi-environment validation (Dev, QA, Staging, Production). Established detailed bug reporting with region and environment scope annotations.
uco.result: Increased release confidence across all 3 regions. Reduced manual regression effort significantly. Improved consistency and quality across regions and platforms.

tier1Bank.title: Tier-1 Indonesian Bank — Multi-Module Banking Platform QA
tier1Bank.problem: Complex banking system spanning credit, savings, payments, and transfer modules with frequent releases requiring thorough QA coverage.
tier1Bank.action: Created and maintained automation scripts using Katalon Studio and Selenium. Performed end-to-end, regression, and integration testing across all modules. Coordinated closely with developers and BA to ensure comprehensive coverage.
tier1Bank.result: Achieved approximately 70% automation coverage. Identified 50+ critical issues before release. Reduced production defects and improved feature stability across releases.

snap.title: Bank Indonesia SNAP API — Cryptographic Signature Automation
snap.problem: Bank Indonesia SNAP (Standar Nasional Open API Pembayaran) requires multi-layer cryptographic signing for every transaction — RSA SHA-256 for token authentication, SHA-256 body hashing, and HMAC-SHA512 transaction signing — making manual API testing slow and error-prone.
snap.action: Engineered reusable multi-layer signature utilities in Groovy as Katalon Studio keywords, converted from reference JavaScript implementations. Designed data-driven test suites covering 20+ scenarios per endpoint across HTTP status codes 200, 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 500, and 504, with Excel-based scenario binding.
snap.result: Automated SNAP-compliant payment APIs (Balance Inquiry, SKNBI Transfer, RTGS Transfer, Direct Debit). Reduced API regression cycle time substantially and provided reusable signing keywords adopted across the team.

qoin.title: Fintech E-Wallet — Flutter App Quality
qoin.problem: Critical financial features in e-wallet applications requiring high accuracy and stability. Bugs in transaction flows could mean real money loss for users.
qoin.action: Conducted API and mobile testing with focus on transaction accuracy. Validated transaction flows and edge cases across multiple e-wallet products. Built automation suites covering 150+ test scenarios using Selenium and Katalon Studio. Coordinated mass simulation testing across 4 sessions with 15–20 concurrent testers to validate concurrency and stability under load.
qoin.result: Contributed to 30% reduction in post-release defects. Improved reliability of transaction features. Reduced critical bugs reaching production.
